tips: | Bad matchup early levels and since you have only 22 starting Magic Resistance the matchup can be hard. However if you avoid getting Charmed by her E and never getting full combo'ed you should be fine. Stand behind minions and farm safely until your level 6 and Blasting Wand. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| You barely outrange her Q range with your E so with that being said dont look for any extended trades against her and farm safely till your level 6 and blasting want. After that try to take short trades using your Q through minions AA + E and then go back. You cant really get killed on midlane since its a short lane but even after level 11 she wins you on sidelane because she can force your R with 3 different ways and has the most dangerous gap closers. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Really hard matchup and can be unplayble if enemey Akshan is really good and zones you off every minion that you try to take. However if you manage to survive till Blasting Wand and level 6 thats when you want to start taking small trades. Take his bone plating with a Q before trying to take a short trade and try to avoid his Q so he can only AA you twice while you Q+AA+E him and W'ing out wining the trade. Level 11 you win on sidelane. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Farm up to 6 try to avoid her Q by baiting that you are going for a minion buy Blasting Wand and try to take short trades. Sadly even on 11 you dont have prio against her so she is going to be always first on the rotates for objectives or some roam all you can do is ping it and Hard-push the next wave so she loses something atleast. You can win her on sidelane if you manage to dodge her Q unless she has phase rush. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Simple but hard matchup. Avoid walking up for a trade or to farm when she has her stun ready since she can burst you down to even 30% of your Hp depending on her Items and Runes. Start taking short trades with blasting want and level 6+ once she doesnt have her stun ready. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| It is an easy matchup but it can go very wrong if he gets a lead early on. If he tries to zone you off the wave level 1 if you play your passive well and not take aggro from all enemy minions you can win the 1v1 or get his flash and at the slightest wining the trade. Once you get 1150 Gold, back as soon as possible and buy Recurve Bow and Cull. This way you can out Dps him on every trade without any problem. Keep your passive stacked so you can get some more AA's off. On sidelane with level 11 you win and Boots of Swiftness . Doran's Blade as your starting item.
| DODGE / BAN.

| Used to be an easy matchup but nowdays it is an even 1. Dont take any damage early on rush Blasting Wand with level 6 and make sure you damage him first to remove his first strike so he doesnt deal a crazy amount of damage with First Strike + E. On sidelane against him you should be fun as long as you didnt fall behind or he is not very ahead. You can close the gap between you and him with Boots of Swiftness + W and take his Flash. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Avoid his Q at all costs so he cant take a full trade with Electrocute or Hail of blades. Since his Q slows if you avoid it there is no way for him to get 3 Auto Attacks on you since you are faster than him with your W, Celerity, Fleet, Passive and Boots of Swiftness. This way if he engages a fight with E, instantly Q him and kite him. Buy Blasting Wand and avoid taking stunned by his W since you dont want to use your R before his. Sidelane it can go both good and bad. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Noway of you wining a trade against Him. If you try to Q him and AA him he is going to dash into you with Q+AA And also his W which is gonna active electrocute and get you down to 65% of your Hp while he can dash out with his E after wining the trade. Really hard Matchup and all you can do is farm until he makes a big mistake. However if he starts the fight with his E then you can win the trade. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Dont get to close to him since he can E and then W you resulting into an 100% wining trade for him thanks to his shield from his W and his burst outcome. Try to connect 1-2 Auto Attacks and then go back. If you start the fight with Q it is even better because he is gonna be slowed for a little bit. Both Recurve Bow and Blasting Wand work on this matchup. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Playable matchup on midelane but she can still hard punish you if you over extend and get hit by her E while she has her passive stacked so if you dodge her E with any way she cant do anything. Rush Recurve Bow and try to damage her from distance and also stay close to your tower so she cant engage to you. Since you go Fleet Footwork for your runes you are going to have an easier time on lane but after 15 minutes mark if she is a good Irelia she can win the sidelane. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Mainly Jayce mid is gonna be seen in high elo mostly. Get safely to level 6 and rush Blasting Wand. Keep your passive stacked always against this matchup. The only way you win trades against his is if you W while he Jumps on you and creating a gap so he cant knock you back and kite him with your Q and Auto Attacks. If he has Phase Rush as his runes it is really hard to play against him both laning phase and sidelane since he can always disengage after taking a bad or even good trade. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Nearly unplayable matchup not matter how good or bad he is as a player. She can match your movement speed easily and zone you from the wave whenever she has Q ready. Not only but she can always heal up to 100% of her Hp for free. Not much you can do really you still have couple of chances to win if she is really bad. Rush Blasting Wand and try to take really short trades on places that she cant R+Q you. Only good thing on this matchup is that on sidelane you can 1v1 her with Level 11+. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| The only Matchup that you want to build damage build. Build Order is Kraken > Guinsoo's Rageblade > Phantom Dancer > Terminus > Jak'Sho, The Protean with any boots you want but mainly Boots of Swiftness but dont rush them early instead finish Kraken as soon as possible and max Q as your main ability. Change Secondary Runes from Celerity and Gathering storm to Conditioning and Overgrowth from resolve tree. These changes are only meant for this matchup but you can win on sidelane aswell. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Take prio against her Level 1 and 2 after you push the second wave make sure to ward the enemy raptors since you are able to get prio into this matchup. Let her push the third and fourth wave into you and ping the location she is going to roam at. First back get Recurve bow and after level 6 have your passive stacked always incase she engages on you. Really easy matchup that you also win on the sidelane. Doran's Blade as your starting item.
| DODGE.

| Avoiding her Q's gives her 0 chances of wining a short trade your Auto Attacks have bigger range than her W by a bit so if you connect a Q through minions with Level 6+ and Blasting Wand gives her 0 chances of wining or making the trade even. The only bad part about this matchup is if she is good and zones you off the wave and lastly it is hard to react to her R with your R before she stuns you. Sadly she will always have prio and a tool to engage and disengage which is her E. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| Just like every other mage matchup this 1 aswell isnt on your favor since you lack basic Magic Resistance. Try to dodge her abilities and stay as high Hp as possible. Sidelane you win but on laning phase there isnt much to talk about it is all about lane knowledge movement reactions etc. Doran's Shield as your starting item.

| Free farm against this matchup and you eventually outscale him. Rush cull against this matchup and farm as much as possible. Take his passive off before trying to engage into a short trade with level 6+ and Blasting Wand. This matchup can go really wrong since you can only predict when he is going to R you and not to react to it since you will be silenced. However on teamfights if you position well you should be fine. Doran's Shield as your starting item.

| One of the hardest assassins to deal with and that is because of his Point and click gap closer which has no counterplay. However if you have a good position and you have the wave close to your tower you can punish him with level 6+ and Blasting wand but also take his first strike rune off resulting into less damage for you if he tries to trade back. Sidesteping his Q's and baiting them on this matchup can be lane changing and game changing too. Doran's Blade as your starting item.
| I would recommend to also dodge this matchup but if you end up playing it, it is going to be really hard. Her poke outrange you really hard

| One of the hardest matchups. Against Oriana all you can do and want to do is pretty much farm because there is noway you get any close to her and even if you do she will hard win the trade due to her Q W. Swap runes from Celerity and Gathering storm to Second Wind and overgrowth. Doran's shield as your starting item and avoid trades until level 11 unless she is really bad.

| Qiyana matchup can go just fine but there are times that she will be out of control. Level 1 and 2 you are way stronger than her stack your passive and slow push the first wave while poking her with E. Level 2 hardpush the wave and ward enemy raptors so you have vision where the jungler is and once you spot him play on the other side of the lane. Level 3 and 4 if you already poked her down by a lot and you see a kill potential pressure her whenever she tries to take a trade if not just let her push the wave and ping the potential roam that she will be making unless she goes back. After that if you cant push the next wave you got teleport so go back and buy Blasting Wand for short and distant Q trades. Doran's blade as your starting item and be careful on sidelane.

| Hard matchup but it depends on how good the enemy ryze is. Thankfully there are not a lot of players that pick Ryze which is a benefit for us. However it is a hard matchup due to his range and speed that he gets. He can zone really easy with his W + AA on Level 1 + Scorch and level 2,3,4 etc the same thing but even harder. You can win short trades if you connect your Q through the wave into him and have your passive stacked. After level 11 matchup is easier and especially on sidelane. Both Doran's Blade and Shield work in this matchup if game is played in higher elo go for Shield.

| Really easy laning phase all you have to do is not get hit by all of his spells especially his E which will give him stacks for free and just farm. At level 6 after your first back assuming you either have Recurve Bow or Blasting Wand you are looking for short trades. If you have a good movement in the entire trade he is only gonna be able to hit you with a Q while you are Auto Attacking him 5 times + Q and your E. Doran's Blade as your Starting item.

| Really hard to play against a good sylas. He has an insane amount of burst which really hurts because you got 22 Magic Resistance on level 1. You have a kill window at level 1 if you stack your passive on the wave and he E's into you. After that level 2-3-4-5-6 etc are in his favor. Try to stand behind minions and not to get E'ed and most importantly keep your passive stacked incase he tries something. Also in a close 1v1 fight whoever Ult's first loses the fight. Blade as your Starting item.

| Very hard matchup aswell. Against syndra you want to switch your runes a bit and instead of Celerity and Gathering storm, go with Second Wind and Overgrowth. You need all the sustain you can in this lane because of her poke and burst. Farm up safely dont take bad trades and wait for your level 11.The only chances you have to win a trade is if she misses her e and also on sidelane after your level 11 + your boots if she misses her E you can W into her and kill her with your R and damage. Doran's Shield as your Starting item.

| Simple matchup but still a mage that hurts. Not much to say about this matchup no need to switch your runes but you still got to be careful not to get hit by anything. Most of mage matchups depends if you are going to hit by everything or no. Stand behind minions and after level 6+ try to take safe short trades. On sidelane with level 11 you win. Doran's Shield as your starting item.

| A good matchup for Kayle but can still go very wrong if you dont respect him as much as you should. Level 1 poke him down with your E denying his Level 2-3 all in. Level 6+ start trades with Q and make sure not to get hit by his second W. If you dont there is no way you lose a trade against him since you also outrange his W by a bit. Only thing that can really mess up with matchup is if he gets a lot of kills on the sidelane out of roams. Do not panic with your R against him and pressure the sidelane after level 11 since there is no way of you following his roams. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| It can be a really hard matchup due to his itemization. Early levels there is nothing you can do just farm safely up to 6 get your first back and buy Blasting Wand and then start looking for some short trades after he uses his W. Level 6+ you cant follow his roams but if you see a potential Tp on the side that he is R'ing make sure to give it a try. All starting items work against him Including Doran's Ring

| The only AP matchup that can be somewhat easy. Afk farm until level 6 and after your first back which you want it to be Blasting Wand + Cull, start taking short | trades with your Q. All you have to respect is his E which you will try not to get stunned by and his R which you can R. Doran's Ring against him as your starting item.

| A bit harder than Veigar matchup because he can punish you earlier. Level 1 till 6 try to take really limited damage by him and use your abilities to sustain and farm on the lane. After your first recall which will be Blasting Wand you can start taking some short trades but make sure you dodge his E so he doesn't Force your R after you get hit by it. All starting items work against him depends on what you feel better with.

| A good vex can be really hard to deal with. If she holds her fear and does not spend it for nothing she will be able to zone you a lot and deny you a lot of minions and potential some Xp too. Her burst damage is a real problem for you and the key to this matchup is if you can avoid to get hit by the fear. Level 6+ buy blasting want on your first recall and try to bait her fear out by acting that you are going for a minion or for a trade. Doran's Ring and Blade work for this matchup but not shield since her main damage comes out of a burst action.

| Another really hard mage matchup similar to Syndra. Switch your runes a bit and instead of Celerity and Gathering storm, go with Second Wind and Overgrowth. Try to avoid getting in range for his Q and farm as much as you can. If you only get hit by his E and some Auto Attacks you should be fine with your sustain. Even after level 6 and Blasting Wand trades look really hard for you unless he is really bad at the champ or as a player. Level 11 is where you win and its mostly on sidelane so try not to die in this lane and farm as much as you can. Doran's Shield as your starting item.

| Against vlad avoid ALL early game trades until Blasting Wand and level 6. Key to this matchup is to avoid his empowered Q and take short trades with your Q behind your minions so she cant E you. Level 11 is where you auto-win the matchup and especially on sidelane you are much stronger than him. Doran's Blade as your starting item

| A really skilled matchup for both of you. Level 1 you can poke him down with E or start Q to last hit all 3 minions. Level 2 till 6 there is no point trying to trade against him. When you engage in a short fight with him try to stay behind the wave so he cant stun you with his E. On sidelane if you can speed up to him and close the gap using your Movement Speed and dodge his E, you have a free kill that will benefit you a lot but that requires level 11+. Doran's Shield as your starting item

| Avoid taking trades pre 6 at all costs. If he is clever he has Second Wind and Doran's Shield so your damage is irrelevant to him. Level 1 farm safely and after level 2 till 6 try to have the wave on your side so he cant close the gap using his E on the wave to get close to you. After his boots (Berserker's Greaves) The matchup becomes really harder for you. Try to stay away from the wave and that goes for sidelaning too. You dont have lethal tempo to match his so you want to avoid extended trades at all costs. Both Yasuo and Yone matchups are really skilled and depend to the players. Doran's Blade as your starting Item.

| Yone is really similar to Yasuo matchup. Similar kit runes items and gameplay. Stay away from him at all costs and after level 11+ you have chances to win him on the sidelane if you dodge his R and space really well. Both Yasuo and Yone matchups are really skilled and depend to the players. Doran's Blade as your starting Item.

| Not much you can do against him it really depends on how good he is. In general try to avoid his W E Q combo especially if he has first strike so he doesnt get a lot of gold out of it. Rush Blasting Wand as your first item and try to take short trades with him. Overall it is a really skilled matchup especially in higher elos. Dont panic your R against him and keep it for the burst damage that he will apply. The major problem is that after level 6 he can always trade his R for your R and that is not worth at all for you since you have a way higher cooldown on your Ultimate. Try to avoid wasting your R unless you must. Lastly the amount of dashes that he has and teleports doesnt make the game for you easier at all since you cant find a kill potential unless he messes up really hard. Doran's Blade as your starting item.

| He hurts a lot with his Passive and his Q. Luckily for us the champion is not played that much which is 1 less hard matchup. However if you end up playing against Ziggs you want to take a really small amount of damage since his main goal is to poke you out of the lane and take your plates and potential tower with his W. Save your teleport for a good moment and rush Blasting Wand against him. Sadly his W denies any all in potential so there is nothing you can do just simply farm up and avoid taking unnecessary damage. On sidelane after your level 11, if he misses his W you can run him down with your R and Flash but if not try to just pressure the sidelane. Doran;s Shield as your starting item

| Zoe matchup is considered to be 1 of the hardest AP matchups. It is even worse because only Otp's play the champion (One tricks) and they know their limits very well their strengths really good and overall their champion. Stand behind minions and respect her damage. Key to this matchup is to avoid her E and the best way to do that is either maintaining a really high distance with her or standing behind your wave. Blasting Wand rush and start trading with your Q only and stick to a good positioning to avoid taking hit by her E. On sidelane after level 11+ you have higher chances of killing her if she misses her E. Doran's Ring as your first item against her.
